facility.name: Creative World School Georgetown
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2970 FM 1460, GEORGETOWN, TX, 78626

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that a child was left unattended in a classroom while the teachers and children were walking the hallway of the building. This was corrected when the child was reunited with their class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One teacher stated that they had 12 children in care but had 11 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During an investigation it was found that caregivers are yelling at the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver used their personal water bottle to squirt water at a child's face when the child squirted the caregiver with water.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: During an investigation it was found that caregivers are on their phones while they are supposed to be supervising the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver is grabbing children in an aggressive manner for discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed two bathrooms had toilet paper clugged in the toiled, and also there was toilet paper in the ground, and missing toilet paper as well.     It was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: During an investigation it was found that the food was cold when being served to the children and had to be taken back to the kitchen to be rewarmed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: It was found that the operation is not in compliance with the minimum standards regarding ratio's when the director is present in the mornings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver went to sleep while caring for children.   It was also found that a child was left in a classroom by themselves for approximately 1-2 minutes.    There was no evidence to support the allegation that a child was carrying around adult size scissors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report: During investigation it was found there were caregivers aware of multiple allegations of suspected abuse, which was not reported by the operation.    This was corrected when we spoke to the operation's staff about how and when to make reports.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During an investigation it was found that multiple classrooms have been out of ratio more than one time. It was found that the classrooms are mostly out of ratio on Wednesday, Thursday and every other Friday mornings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During an investigation, there was evidence to support the allegation that caregivers are yelling at the kids in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: 2 caregivers did not know how many children they had.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: The operation did not report a suspected abuse within the required 48 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During any investigation there was evidence to support the allegation that a caregiver would yell at the children for discipline
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: During an investigation it  was found that a caregiver grabbed a child by their arm for discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: One Seat Belt Per Person: During an investigation, it was found that 2 children had to share a seat on the bus during after school pick up on at least one occasion. The operation has changed their transportation procedure in response to this incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: One Seat Belt Per Person (26 TAC §746.5613)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: A fire inspection had not been completed for the operation since 2023. A sprinkler system test was completed, but after calling the city, it was determined that the operation had not been inspected since 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: One child did not have a physician statement indicating the child was well enough to attend the child care operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child was missing one immunization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was a caregiver present caring for children who did not have a cleared background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During an investigation, it was found that a caregiver kicked a chair into the table with a child sitting in the chair.  It was also observed on video a caregiver grabbing a child's arm aggressively, grabbing a child by the jaw and sitting a child down firmly on the floor.   A caregiver was also seen yanking a toy out of a childs hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: There was no documentation of a fire drill for February 2023. This was corrected when the drill was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: During the inspection the infant feeding written instructions did not have a parent signature for infants not on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: During the inspection children were observed transitioning from free play to the table for lunch without washing hands prior to food being placed in front of them. This was corrected by the children washing their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))
